## Production Case Studies & Impact

### 1. Campaign Processing & Delivery Pipeline Overhaul (Poptin)
- Role: Senior Backend Engineer
- Stack: Laravel, AWS SNS, AWS SES, CloudWatch, Redis, Horizon
- Problem: High-volume email platform experiencing server crashes from synchronous webhook callbacks and sequential subscriber sending.
- Solution: Decoupled SNS delivery webhooks asynchronously via Redis queues. Refactored delivery into parallel batched execution with real-time memory monitoring.
- Impact: 46.6% faster campaign completion, 87.4% higher throughput, 35.8% faster batch execution, and zero production crashes under peak load.

### 2. Healthcare Platform Cloud Migration (Gerocare)
- Role: Lead Software Engineer
- Stack: Laravel, Vue.js, Google Cloud Platform (Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, GCS), Nginx, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare
- Problem: Critical telemedicine and doctor-visit workflows failing due to outages on legacy shared hosting.
- Solution: Led full cloud migration to GCP with Cloud SQL and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD; executed via zero-downtime DNS cutover with rollback path.
- Impact: 100% elimination of recurring downtime, ~40% faster application load times, zero data loss, and sustained production stability.

### 3. Luxury Ecommerce Backend: Multi-Currency & Search (Hypetag)
- Role: Lead Backend Engineer
- Stack: Laravel, MySQL, Laravel Scout, DigitalOcean, Cloudinary, Paystack
- Problem: Discovery and checkout needed under cost constraints with dynamic currency display vs charging rules.
- Solution: Tuned MySQL full-text search with Laravel Scout; built dynamic multi-currency rates adjustment layer with clear fallback charging logic.
- Impact: Cost-effective search relevance, transparent multi-currency transactions, and resilient order/payment lifecycles.

### 4. Scalable Directory Backend: Safe Ingestion & High-Relevance Search (Connect Nigeria)
- Role: Backend Engineer
- Stack: Laravel, MySQL, Meilisearch, Laravel Scout, Algolia, AWS ElastiCache, AWS S3, GitLab CI/CD
- Problem: Inconsistent field agent spreadsheet uploads causing corrupt data and slow discovery across large directories.
- Solution: Built strict validation and deduplication import pipeline; deployed dedicated Meilisearch instance with custom business ranking rules.
- Impact: Safe high-volume ingestion, instant search response times, and reliable operational tooling.

## Engineering Principles

1. System Design First: Scalability, maintainability, and reliability drive architectural decisions. Every component exists for an explicit purpose.
2. Performance by Default: Performance is designed into database schema, query patterns, and API lifecycles from day one.
3. Pragmatic Engineering: Ship measurable value without taking on unmanaged technical debt. Choose the right tool for the problem rather than following trends.
4. Reliability & Observability: Resilient failure handling, observable telemetry, and verification boundaries built into both classical backends and probabilistic AI systems.
5. Deterministic Boundaries: AI models are probabilistic, but the surrounding software must remain deterministic with strict contracts, constrained tool permissions, and explicit fallback paths.
